principle: Expose one canonical NUI knowledge system through thin agent-specific surfaces; a bridge changes discovery and invocation, never design authority.

adapters.evidence: OpenAI Codex repository skill tests at pinned upstream commit document .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md discovery; official Codex documentation covers CLI/MCP integration.
adapters.permission_boundary: Codex sandbox and approval policy remain host-controlled; NUI does not broaden them.

adapters.evidence: Anthropic Claude Code documentation defines project skills under .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and MCP/CLI configuration.
adapters.permission_boundary: Claude Code tool permissions and hooks remain host-controlled; imported NUI skills cannot self-grant tools.

adapters.surface: workspace agent skill + AGENTS.md/GEMINI context + MCP/CLI
adapters.evidence: Google Antigravity documentation defines workspace skills under .agents/skills and supports skills, MCP, hooks and subagents.
adapters.permission_boundary: Antigravity command/MCP permission policy remains authoritative; NUI adapters request no implicit privilege.

adapters.evidence: Model Context Protocol defines host-controlled tools/resources/prompts over transports such as stdio/HTTP.
adapters.permission_boundary: The MCP host decides server connection, transport and tool approval; NUI MCP exposes bounded local analysis only.

adapters.evidence: Portable process boundary requiring no vendor-specific prompt format.
adapters.permission_boundary: CLI inherits the caller operating-system permissions and never installs or executes third-party skills automatically.
